title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 148
description: Ten questions on Psalms 148: a call for angels, sun and moon, sea creatures, kings and children all to praise Yahweh's name.

questions.text: From where does the psalm first call for Yahweh to be praised?
questions.explanation: It opens, "Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!"

answers.text: From the heavens, in the heights
From the ends of the earth

questions.text: Which heavenly lights are told to praise him in verse 3?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!"

answers.text: The sun, moon and shining stars

questions.text: Why should the heavens and their hosts praise Yahweh's name, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: They should praise Yahweh's name, "for he commanded, and they were created."

answers.text: Because he rides on the clouds
Because he commanded, and they were created

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about the decree God has made?
questions.explanation: He has established them forever and ever, and has made a decree which will not pass away.

answers.text: It is written on tablets of stone
It is sealed until the end

questions.text: Which creatures are called to praise Yahweh "from the earth" in verse 7?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths."

answers.text: Lions and all beasts of prey
Great sea creatures and all depths
Fish and all that swarms in the rivers

questions.text: What is the stormy wind said to be doing?
questions.explanation: Among lightning, hail, snow and clouds, the stormy wind is described as fulfilling his word.

questions.text: Which trees are named in the psalm's call to praise?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 calls on mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars.

questions.text: Which human rulers are summoned to praise Yahweh in verse 11?
questions.explanation: The psalm calls on kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth.

answers.text: The elders and all the officers of Israel
Kings of the earth, princes and all judges
Pharaoh and all the servants of his house
The governors of all the provinces

questions.text: Why should they all praise Yahweh's name, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: They should praise his name, "for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens."

answers.text: His name alone is exalted; his glory is above earth and heavens
His mercy endures forever toward all generations
His voice breaks the cedars of Lebanon in pieces
His throne is established in justice and in truth

questions.text: What has Yahweh lifted up for his people, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: The psalm ends saying he has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, the children of Israel, a people near to him.
